Geometry/wording anchored on the Sept 11-12 2020 west-coast smoke event (King County, WA). UGC WAC033 + SAME 053033 = King County, WA.

properties.headline: Air Quality Alert issued September 11 for King County until September 12 by NWS Seattle WA
properties.description:
* WHAT...The Washington State Department of Ecology has issued an Air Quality Alert for wildfire smoke. PM2.5 concentrations in the unhealthy range.

* WHERE...King County.

* WHEN...Until noon PDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Wildfire smoke from the west coast will impact air quality. Sensitive groups should limit prolonged outdoor exertion.
properties.instruction: Limit outdoor activity. Close windows and run air conditioning if available.
